summary: The daemon's built-in targets are the objectives it ships in slo/objectives.kdl, read by the objective reader; slo/targets.toml is gone

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Behavior is unchanged: the same 25 rows with the same ids, abouts, targets and windows in st slo, GET /v1/slo, the request-latency read, st doctor and the OTLP gauges. The file is built into each daemon, so no running config changes. writer-hold reads its own objective's 300 ms bound, equal to the transaction bound it used before; st_slo_target_ms's description names slo/objectives.kdl.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback restores the TOML-built targets, which are the same numbers.
